rubric.criterion: The workflow first confirms that IncidentLifecycle is the canonical state and transition owner.
The review supports retaining IncidentLifecycle and carries its invariants into implementation recommendations; a separate handoff or DESCEND label is optional.
Only then does the simplicity stage identify IncidentFacade as a one-use forwarding module that can be deleted.
The recommendation preserves idempotency, recovery, and durable outbox intent through the IncidentLifecycle interface.
The forwarding-module recommendation relies on a supported ownership conclusion and preserves its invariants. Separate stages, contexts and a particular execution order are not required.
